resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 7,330 ft (2,234 m); the Peakbagging photo caption gives 7374 ft with no method. The record's 2234.2 m matches the Register, so the Register figure is used. An onX page gives a peak height of 7,365 ft for a nearby summit, which is not the lookout's site elevation.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1937), height (32 ft) and standing status agree across the Register, Peakbagging and the FFLA county list. Staffing rests on Peakbagging's code table (AS), not a staffing roster; as_of is the table's revision date. No source names a specific fire, a staffing history or a visitor rule. The access and visit notes rely on the onX trail page, which is commercial, and do not say whether the cab can be entered or climbed. A 1936 benchmark disk under the tower is mentioned on the Peakbagging photo page; not used, since no source ties it to the 1937 build. A Wikipedia Turkey_Butte URL returned 404. The Peakbagging table gives Turkey Butte a usually-staffed code; no recent staffing confirmation was found. FFLA index coordinates (35.03206, -111.90419) differ from the Register's (35.032000, -111.903300) by roughly 80 m; no correction proposed. No photos added.
